bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598)" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 63
docker logs --tail 200 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 64
printf 'EXISTING_PROFILE_DRY_RUN_BEGIN\n'
result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs --dry-run)" || exit 65
printf '%s\n' "$result"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"mode":"--dry-run"' || exit 66
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"existing_posts":7' || exit 67
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"applied":0' || exit 68
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 69
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'PROFILE_BACKFILL_RECEIPTS='||count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill;"
echo NO_EXISTING_POST_MUTATION=PASS
echo PROFILE_BACKFILL_DRY_RUN=PASS
